title: Jur'ah evaluation set: routing inputs
description: Varied inputs to the Orchestrator, each with the route it must take (AI Agents Acceptance Criteria section 6). At least 3 must be the realistic confusion between a medicine box and a prescription (boxOrPrescription: true), and at least 1 must come from a caregiver.

owed.description: The owed-value marker of an empty set. Delete it once the set holds its minimum.

trackingOn.description: For a patient: whether adherence check-ins are switched on. Default true.

text.description: The message, the caption of a photo or document, or the text of a start command.

file.description: The photo or document, relative to the data file.

expected.description: adherence: the Adherence Agent. extraction: Prescription Extraction. travel_check: Travel Check. link: the link-confirmation path, never an agent. clarify: the Orchestrator asks with two buttons (an unsure photo, or a resumed choice that has expired). caregiver_reply: an active caregiver's short reply, never the adherence path. other_reply: a photo the Orchestrator reads as neither a prescription nor a medicine box (AP-11). no_agent: nothing at all, no reply that reveals a patient exists. tracking_off_reply: tracking is off, the short explanation.

boxOrPrescription.description: true for a photo that could be read as a medicine box or as a prescription.
